children.title: Provenance Maps
children.sub: Ten hand-authored maps declaring where every line of every tax form gets its value
children.detail: Each map is a static record keyed by semantic line keys (like `1040nr.1a`) with formula, sources, engine fields, and code location; dynamic rows use regex patterns. Drift-guard tests fail the build when maps diverge; ENGINE_FIELD_CONTRIBUTIONS maps 14 fields.

code.label: LineProvenance: formula, sources, engineFields, codeRef
LinePattern: regex-matched provenance for dynamic rows
resolveProvenance: exact match first, then pattern
AUDIT_FORMS: ten provenance maps and AUDIT_FORM_BY_ID lookup
ENGINE_FIELD_CONTRIBUTIONS: 14 fields mapped to document boxes
Header: keys like 1040nr.1a, drift-guard test reference
PROVENANCE_1040NR: Record<string, LineProvenance> keyed by semantic line keys
Comment: drift-guard tests fail the build
resolveTreaty: replaces Indonesia sample articles with filer's actual country treaty at runtime
